requirements.statement: A Dieter can set calorie and macro goals

criteria.must: A Dieter can enter a calorie target and macro targets
A saved goal is shown back to the Dieter

requirements.statement: A Dieter can browse a recipe catalog with nutrition information

criteria.must: A Dieter can view a list of recipes
Each recipe shows its calorie and macro information

requirements.statement: A Dieter can build a meal plan for upcoming days from recipes

criteria.must: A Dieter can add a recipe to a meal plan for a specific day and meal slot
The Dieter can view their planned meals for the days ahead

requirements.statement: A Dieter can log meals they actually ate

criteria.must: A Dieter can log a meal they ate
Logged meals appear in the Dieter's food log history

requirements.statement: A Dieter can see daily calorie and macro totals against their goal

criteria.must: The Dieter's daily calorie total reflects their logged food
The daily total is shown alongside the Dieter's goal for comparison

requirements.statement: A Dieter can track their weight over time

criteria.must: A Dieter can record a weight entry with a date
Recorded weight entries are viewable as a history over time

requirements.statement: A Dieter can order a planned lunch directly through Uber Eats from within the app

criteria.must: A Dieter can trigger an Uber Eats order for a planned lunch meal without leaving the app
The Dieter sees confirmation that the lunch order was placed

requirements.statement: A Dieter can invite a coach to connect to their account

criteria.must: A Dieter can send a coach connection invitation
The invited coach connection appears in the Dieter's list of connections

requirements.statement: A Coach can see the plans, logs, and progress of the Dieters connected to them

criteria.must: A Coach can view a list of Dieters connected to them
A Coach can view a connected Dieter's meal plan, food log, and weight progress

requirements.statement: A Coach can leave feedback and recommendations on a Dieter's plan or progress

criteria.must: A Coach can submit feedback on a connected Dieter's plan or progress
Submitted feedback is associated with the correct Dieter connection

requirements.statement: A Dieter is notified on WhatsApp when their coach leaves feedback

criteria.must: A WhatsApp notification is triggered when a Coach leaves feedback for a Dieter
The WhatsApp notification content reflects the feedback that was left

requirements.statement: Sign-in is via SSO through the platform identity provider for every actor

criteria.must: A Dieter must sign in via SSO before accessing their diet data
A Coach must sign in via SSO before accessing connected Dieters' data

requirements.statement: A Coach can be connected to more than one Dieter and a Dieter to more than one Coach

criteria.must: A single Coach can have connections to multiple Dieters at once
A single Dieter can have connections to multiple Coaches at once
